texts: Freedom from tricuspid insufficiency is 80 percent at 20 years after the Carpentier repair: B, as the book gives it.
Carpentier's repair mobilizes the anterior leaflet, plicates the atrialized chamber longitudinally and supports the annulus with a ring, giving a durable valve.
In the cone repair of da Silva, the leaflets are mobilized and rotated into a cone fixed at the true annulus, and the right ventricle becomes smaller afterwards, so D is wrong.
The other figures, for the Danielson, Augustin and one and a half ventricle repairs, are not the ones the book reports.
In the picture, eight of ten carpenter-mended tridents are still shut tight after 20 candles.
Memory hook: the carpenter's trident holds, 80 percent at 20.
